result.description: B2B support platform (Slack/Teams/email shared channels, ticketing, account management, AI agents) with a REST API for issues, accounts, contacts.
result.auth_detail: REST API: admin-created Bearer API token (non-expiring, role-scoped). OAuth2 exists only for the hosted MCP server (Member/Admin seat), not the public REST API.
result.access_detail: No public self-serve signup or free plan. Pricing page CTAs are 'Book a demo'/'Talk to sales'; trials only via a sales rep; annual contracts with minimum seats. Tokens come from inside an existing paying (or sales-provisioned trial) workspace, created by an Admin. REST API is included in all tiers; Sandbox is Enterprise only.
result.api_notes: REST API at api.usepylon.com (US) / api.eu.usepylon.com (EU), with SDKs for TypeScript, Python and Go plus an experimental CLI. Covers issues, accounts, contacts and more. Endpoint list is in the API reference, which I did not fetch, so breadth is an estimate.
result.blocker: No self-serve signup or free sandbox. Working credentials need an existing Pylon customer workspace (sales-led trial or paid contract) and an Admin to create the token. Composio would need a partner or test account from Pylon.

evidence.quote: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication.
Only Admins can create and manage API tokens.
Your sales representative will work with you on setting up the demo organization.
Pylon's API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.
The Pylon MCP server at https://mcp.usepylon.com provides AI tools access to your Pylon data.
The Pylon MCP server only supports OAuth authentication. API key authentication is not currently available.
